notes: No corpus evidence is recorded, and none can be: the production matches the empty string, so no line of text is an instance of it in any way a reader could check. The clause and the pilot grammar are the whole of the evidence.
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.17.4. The clause and the Xtext state this production identically — `ownedRelatedElement += EmptyUsage` in both — so there is nothing to weigh. It contributes no tokens: EmptyUsage is `{}`, and the whole point of the production is to occupy a parameter position in the abstract syntax that the concrete syntax leaves unwritten. That is why it appears in rules such as SendNodeDeclaration's SenderReceiverPart, where `send x to y` has no 'via' sender: the clause supplies an empty parameter where the sender would be, so the two spellings of a send action produce the same shape of model.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription. The pack flags this clause as malformed, but the defect is in TriggerExpression (SYSML21-401) and not in this production, whose own text is well formed.
Second opinion. Identical to the clause.
